name: @edge-tools/needle2
description: Direct and Web Worker JavaScript runtime for Needle 2

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --mode worker && vite build --mode standalone && npm run build:types
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && vitest run && npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck false --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 dist/index.d.ts dist/standalone.d.ts && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck false --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --lib ES2022 dist/index.d.ts dist/standalone.d.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:native-library: npm run native:build && deno test --allow-ffi --allow-read tests/native-library-compatibility.ts && bun test ./tests/native-library-compatibility.ts
